facts.fact: The 2026 Estimates of National Expenditure appropriate R767.2m for 2026/27 to Vote 30's Digital Communication, Access and Services programme (Digital and Postal Access and Services subprogramme); R595.5m of it is the Post Office postal universal-service subsidy and R146.0m goes to the universal service and access bodies.
facts.system: Vote 30 Digital and Postal Access and Services, 2026/27

facts.fact: The same subprogramme rises from R742.9m (2025/26 adjusted) to R767.2m (2026/27), and to R801.1m and R833.3m in the two years after; the line includes the R595.5m postal subsidy.
facts.system: Vote 30 Digital and Postal Access and Services, 2026/27

facts.fact: The 2026/27 estimates name a transfer of R57.209m to the Universal Service and Access Fund and R88.793m to the Universal Service and Access Agency of South Africa, from the National Revenue Fund; the fund's broadcasting digital migration window is appropriated nil for 2026/27 and across the MTEF, against R59.4m in 2022/23.
facts.system: Universal Service and Access Fund, 2026/27 transfer
